messages:
incident-bot: [P1 ALERT] billing.token_heartbeat missing in eu-west-1 for ~00:20. Overflag count +12 customers. Pager: billing-metrics.
ops-bot: background: emitter service (billing-emitter) reported intermittent EPIPEs around 00:18-00:22 UTC. Auto-suppression applied to avoid noisy alerts.
natalie: I'm oncall — grabbing this. tagging @alana @mike for quick triage. any visible customer impact?
alana: looking at dashboards (https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/billing?panel=token_heartbeat). heartbeat gap aligns w/ spike in emitter lag. some orgs getting overage flags in product UI.
mike: confirmed — our alerting shows 8 orgs with transient overage flags; support already got ~3 tickets. not yet billing invoices, just UI flags. digging emitter logs now.
ben: quick dump from emitter pod (emitter-5):
```bash
$ kubectl -n billing logs emitter-5 --tail=200
2026-03-18T00:18:12Z WARN commit loop: paused for 31s
2026-03-18T00:18:43Z ERROR write failed: EPIPE
2026-03-18T00:19:10Z WARN reconnecting, pool exhausted
```
looks like tcp writes to metering-aggregator were failing; backlog accumulating locally.
alana: can we restart the emitter deployment to clear stuck connections? runbook suggests restart + replay of backlog with dedupe.
ops-bot: runbook snippet: `runbook billing/emit-backfill` steps: (1) restart deploy `kubectl rollout restart deploy/billing-emitter -n billing` (2) kick off backfill job `scripts/backfill_emits --start 00:00 --end 00:30 --dedupe` (3) monitor `billing:reconcile` job.
natalie: OK proceed with restart. @ben please coordinate; @mike prepare finance/support note.
ben: restarting now -> `kubectl rollout restart deploy/billing-emitter -n billing`
ben: rollout reported READY after 2 pods cycled. emitter heartbeat resumed at 00:24.
alana: heartbeat recovered but we estimate ~1.2M tokens missing from 00:18-00:24 window (based on emitter offsets). backfill needed. recommend paced replay to avoid creating duplicate charge flags.
mike: agree. important: backfill must set `source=replay` header and use dedupe keys (seq_id + org_id) so billing pipeline will ignore duplicates. I'm preparing finance ping.
emma: support draft: "We've detected transient billing UI flags for a small set of customers during 00:18-00:24 UTC. We're running a safe backfill; customers will not be charged twice. We'll follow up within 2 hours with status." Shall I send now to affected orgs or wait until reconcile dry-run?
mike: wait for dry-run results, then send. I'll cc finance (finance@redwood.com) once dry-run confirms no duplication.
ops-bot: triggered dry-run: `python tools/reconcile_backfill.py --start 00:18 --end 00:24 --dry-run --dedupe` -> estimated replay size 1.18M tokens, preview shows 0 potential duplicate keys.
alana: good. proceed with paced replay at 50k tokens/min to keep downstream stable. launching job.
ben: replay started at 00:36. monitoring aggregator throughput and queue depth. so far steady.
incident-bot: system: automatic overage-flag suppression cleared for 8 orgs at 00:40 after suppression TTL extended.
natalie: handoff plan: (1) @mike to confirm final finance reconciliation and close suppression by 02:00 UTC; (2) @alana open PR for alert rule on emitter write failures + emitter_pool_exhausted metric; (3) @ben harden emitter connection pool + add circuit breaker.
mike: noted — will loop in finance and confirm by 01:45 UTC.
alana: filing follow-up ticket IN-2026-452 for postmortem and customer-impact spreadsheet. assigning to billing/infra.
emma: will queue customer comms draft to send after finance signoff.
ben: preliminary root cause: long-running embeddings job caused burst of small writes, exhausted emitter's connection pool -> EPIPE cascade. action items: increase pool size, add per-org backpressure, add emitter-level alerting on write EPIPE rate.
natalie: thanks team. marking page resolved in OpsPager. follow-up meeting in 2h. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: closing incident channel note: suppression removed, backfill complete (1.18M tokens re-ingested), no duplicate charges detected in dry-run and monitored replay.
alana: will PR alert and dashboard updates today. leaving digest for postmortem.
mike: finance confirmed no invoice changes; will send a short note to affected customers after we post the postmortem.
natalie: closing thread here — will reopen if new symptoms appear.
